_comment: Seed source registry. Each URL is an official programme or portal home page known at authoring time; none is assumed current. `python3 -m scholarship_agent sources --check` re-checks reachability and robots permission and records the result. Add your own sources in data/sources.local.json (same shape); local entries override seed entries with the same id.
